notes.title: Update About Plasma
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PfoZoExD09U

There's a second game I've been developing on the side along plasma and decided to focus on it since February, Plasma's paused till further notice. If you guys generally like the things I make you may enjoy what I'll be posting up on youtube in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Announcing PLASMA TV!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sY82W1p-iX0

You Are A Pirate - You will Illegally download every movie on the planet.

The DLC is now a full sequel titled PLASMA TV!

Wanna get the sequel for free and watch secret silly videos of us making the game? Ayyyy https://www.patreon.com/TarekGhandour

Here's the latest update for OLDTV.

UPDATE 1.3

FEATURES/FIXES:

 Toggle Sherlock Mode in Options (for speed runners)
 Multiple Functionality fixes (ingame + menus)
 Multiple Language fixes
 Minor Visual tweaks
 Minor Bug fixes


Updates are ongoing - so if something is wrong we usually fix it in a few days without posting it always.

notes.title: Update 'Cyan 1.2' - If you can understand this, this update isn't for you (kinda)
notes.content:
Here's some more juice we brought from the discussion store

FEATURES:
- Game updates are now automatic (no more reinstalling!)
- French
- Traditional Chinese
- Extra Credits

FIXES:
- Simplified Chinese 
- Russian 
- Ukrainian
- Spanish
- German
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Many exploits and minor bugs you guys reported

It was slave labor implementing these languages - not just for me but for the following people too

Hagen (German)
Gabriel Ninô (Brazilian Portuguese)
pixza_Yaoita (Traditional Chinese)
Jidong Zhong (Simplified Chinese)
Ice DiGlacius (Spanish)
and last but much certainly not least, Golden Pen Studios.

Thank these guys^ if it wasn't for them, V would've still looked as ridiculous as it always seemed to foreigners. (I read your comments you bastards)

We wont be implementing an actual Color Blind Mode - I'm very sorry. There's already a considerable amount of work to be done for just two people.

If for some reason you're having issues playing the game try downloading it on another computer - this has solved the case most of the time. If it still persists to crash then you can download it from here http://gamejolt.com/games/v/122286

I'll see you guys on the next update if I'm still alive.

notes.title: Update 'Cyan 1.1' - Personalizing V!
notes.content:
Quite a bit has happened over the past 3 days, here's what we fixed and added!


FEATURES

- FPS Limit
- Screen Resolutions
- Glitch Effects Toggle
- Arrow Keys Functionality
- Localization: Brazilian Portuguese
- Localization: Spanish

FIXES

- Localization German Improved (Thanks Hagen)
- 32-bit support (Should no longer crash)
- Achievement Sync
- Many Minor fixes


Soundtrack, Color blindness, Languages, and more coming real soon!

Remember to reinstall incase update doesn't go through automatically

notes.title: Update in the works
notes.content:
We've been absolutely blown away with the wonderful response from you all since V was released.

Thanks to everyone who reported bugs, pointed out mistakes, made suggestions, etc.
This is helping us improve the game dramatically to bring you a better experience.

We've been working hard and and we're planning to have the first update up within a day or two, which will include a bunch of the fixes and options you've asked for in the discussions.

From then on, we will continue working to bring you more updates.

Stay tuned - pun intended - and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 'Cyan 1.0' is live!!
notes.content:
If you guys have any cool ideas or features you'd like to see in V list them below!

FIXES:

- Tutorial/All Skills achievement fixed
- No more crashes when selecting certain languages at start
- A heck load of minor fixes no one cares about and a few new UI additions

You may need to reinstall the game to update, yes, all 30 seconds of download time.

We're actively reading the discussions and are fixing most of the issues listed (most meaning approx 95%) but right now we're tired and have been fixing this non stop this entire day - I'm gonna go sleep now, we'll be back in a few hours to fix more stuff.

Damn it I forgot to eat lol
